title: Counting vowels
description: count_vowels(text) should return how many letters in text are vowels (a, e, i, o or u, upper or lower case).

bug.summary: range(len(text) - 1) stops one index early, so the last character is never checked.

tests.description: a word ending in a vowel
a longer word with no vowels

hints.1: Pick a word that ends in a vowel and check whether every character, including the last one, gets examined.
hints.2: Look at the loop header on line {line}. Write out the index values it produces for the word "hello".
hints.3: `range(len(text) - 1)` stops one index short, so the last character is never checked. The loop needs to cover every index of the string.
